subject: general
question: Which of the following National Waterways is located in Tamil Nadu?
solution:
The correct answer is __**National Waterway-99**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **National Waterways-99 is located in Tamil Nadu **on the **Tamiraparani River**.
 
• It runs along the stretch of the **Tamiraparani River in Tamil Nadu**, facilitating inland **water transport and connectivity** in the region.
 
• Length:- 62 Km
 
• It is one of the major rivers in **Tamil Nadu,** originating in the **Agasthyamalai hills of the Western Ghats **and flowing through the districts of **Tirunelveli and Thoothukudi** before emptying into the **Gulf of Mannar**.
 
• The **Tamiraparani River **is significant for the agricultural and ecological systems of the region, supporting the livelihoods of many people in the area.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **National Waterway-97**

 
 
• ​SUNDERBANS WATERWAY- **West Bengal**
 
• **Length:- 172 Km**
 
• **NW-97 **encompasses the waterways within the **Sunderbans region**, which is a vast mangrove delta area formed by the confluence of several rivers, including the **Ganges, Brahmaputra, and Meghna.**
 
 
 
• **National Waterway-93**
 
 
• ​SIMSANG RIVER- **Meghalaya**
 
• **Length:- 63 Km**
 
• NW-93 encompasses the **Simsang River,** which is a major river in the **Garo Hills region of Meghalaya**.
 
 
 
• **National Waterway-98**
 
 
• ​SUTLEJ RIVER- **Punjab & Himachal Pradesh**
 
• **Length:- 377 Km**
 
• The development of waterway infrastructure can have significant economic and logistical benefits, particularly for states with extensive river networks like **Punjab and Himachal Pradesh.**
